resources.string: Paste these once. They stay on this phone, encrypted, and only go to Twilio and ElevenLabs.

Open Twilio → API keys → Create. Name it Agent Control, keep the type Standard, tap Create. Copy the two values it shows (SID and Secret). Your Account SID (starts with AC) is on the Twilio home page.
Open ElevenLabs → API keys and tap Create. Turn on Restrict Key, set ElevenLabs Agents to Write, leave the rest at No Access. Copy the key.
The Account SID should start with AC and be 34 characters long.
The API key SID should start with SK and be 34 characters long. (This is not the Account SID.)
The API key Secret looks too short. Paste the Secret Twilio showed you.
The ElevenLabs key looks too short.
Couldn\'t connect. Check your internet connection.
Pull down to refresh the list.
One tap ends one agent\'s live call.
Open Agent Control and set it up first.
Which calls should this widget end?
Set up the app first, then add the widget again.
